vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that tells how often something happens

vocabulary.example: "Usually" is an indefinite adverb of frequency.
I visit my uncle once a month.

vocabulary.note_ar: من ثلاثة فما فوق نقول times
vocabulary.example: I go to the gym three times a week.
You should call your mother daily.
Do you check the reports monthly?
You should renew your licence annually.

vocabulary.meaning_en: make something valid again for a new period
vocabulary.example: I need to renew my passport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official paper that lets you do something, e.g. drive
vocabulary.example: Show me your driving license, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra strength on a word or idea

fine_lines.title: indefinite vs definite frequency
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الظروف غير المحددة (always 100%, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never 0%) لا تخبرنا بالعدد الدقيق. الظروف المحددة تخبرنا بالعدد (twice a week) أو بالفترة (daily, monthly).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Indefinite adverbs (always 100%, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never 0%) don't give an exact number. Definite ones give the number (twice a week) or the time period (daily, monthly).

examples.sentence: I often go to the gym. (How often exactly? We don't know.)
I go to the gym three times a week.

fine_lines.title: once / twice vs one time / two times
fine_lines.explanation_ar: يمكن قول once أو one time، و twice أو two times. من الثلاثة فما فوق نقول three times, four times.
fine_lines.explanation_en: You can say "once" or "one time", "twice" or "two times". From three up: three times, four times.

examples.sentence: I eat fish twice a week.
I eat fish two times a week.

fine_lines.title: annually vs yearly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى نفسه (كل سنة)، لكن annually أكثر استعمالًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Same meaning (every year), but "annually" is more common.

examples.sentence: The company checks its accounts annually.

expressions.meaning_en: A strong complaint that you said it two times already.
expressions.example: Twice I've told you not to do that!
I study English three times a week.
We visit our grandparents once a year.

grammar.title: Number + a + time period
grammar.explanation_ar: لنقول عدد المرات في فترة: once / twice / three times + a + week / month / year. أداة a تعني "أي أسبوع" بشكل عام.
grammar.explanation_en: To say how many times in a period: once / twice / three times + a + week / month / year. The article "a" means any week, in general.
examples: I go to the gym three times a week.
She calls me twice a month.

grammar.title: Time-period adverbs: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, annually
grammar.explanation_ar: هذه الظروف تخبرنا بالفترة التي يتكرر فيها الشيء، ومنها نعرف العدد: monthly = 12 مرة في السنة. نقول annually أكثر من yearly. وقول I go weekly to the gym صحيح نحويًا لكنه غير شائع.
grammar.explanation_en: These adverbs tell the period of repetition, and from that we know the number: monthly = 12 times a year. We say "annually" more than "yearly". "I go weekly to the gym" is correct but not common.
examples: You should renew your licence annually.

grammar.title: Position: at the end (normal) or at the start (emphasis)
grammar.explanation_ar: عادةً نضع ظرف التكرار المحدد في آخر الجملة. إذا وضعناه في أولها فللتوكيد.
grammar.explanation_en: Usually put a definite adverb of frequency at the end of the sentence. Put it at the start for emphasis.
examples: I go to the gym three times a week. (normal)
Twice I've told you not to do that! (emphasis)

grammar.title: Indefinite adverbs (review)
grammar.explanation_ar: always (100%) – usually – often (حوالي 70%) – sometimes – occasionally – rarely – never (0%). تخبرنا كم مرة تقريبًا فقط.
grammar.explanation_en: always (100%) – usually – often (about 70%) – sometimes – occasionally – rarely – never (0%). They only tell how often roughly.
examples: I usually get up at seven.

questions.question: "I go to the gym ___ a week."
questions.explanation_ar: مع a week نحتاج عددًا محددًا: three times.
questions.explanation_en: With "a week" we need an exact number: three times.

questions.question: Which is a definite adverb of frequency?
If you do something monthly, you do it about ___ times a year.
questions.explanation_en: There are 12 months in a year.

questions.question: Where do we usually put "three times a week"?
choices: at the end of the sentence
between the verb and its object
questions.explanation_en: Usually at the end of the sentence.

questions.question: "Twice I've told you not to do that!" Why is "twice" at the start?
Which word is more common than "yearly"?
